children: Stewards amended its agreement with Crom Structured Opportunities Fund to make its $6.05 million unsecured convertible note immediately convertible, rather than starting January 31, 2027. The note was originally issued for $5.5 million, carries a guaranteed 10% interest charge and matures 12 months after its October 28, 2026 issue date. The amendment also permits certain exchanges of legacy debt for shares and allows proceeds to be used to restructure eligible legacy debt after Crom's resale registration statement becomes effective.
: Amendment to an unsecured convertible promissory note and securities purchase agreement
: Accelerate note conversion and permit limited legacy debt exchanges and restructuring
